title: HR dashboard – daily control panel (beta)
html:
The HR dashboard is the starting page of the daily work. It is not a collection of statistics but an operational control panel: it shows where things are stuck and what the next urgent task is.

10.3.1KPI cards at the top

The KPI cards are quick status indicators. For example: Active employees, Open positions, Candidates in progress, Onboarding delays. When clicked, the system jumps to the related list with the filter already applied.

10.3.2Recruitment block

Here you see the distribution of the candidates across the selection steps in a consolidated form. If one column is disproportionately high, there is a bottleneck there (for example too many candidates waiting for an interview).

10.3.3Onboarding block

Around new arrivals, the biggest risk is that not everything is ready for the first day. The dashboard therefore separately indicates the people starting today and tomorrow and the missing mandatory tasks (for example a laptop).

10.3.4Alerts

The alerts list only contains items that require action (for example: End of probation approaching, Offer without a reply, Late onboarding task). Clicking the alert opens the detailed record.
